name: Default No-Blades Support
dsl: ?(deck.remaining >= 2) potent @ spell(any<trap>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<trap & !aoe & stacks>[potent] @ boss | any<trap & aoe & stacks> | any<trap & !aoe>[potent] @ boss | any<trap & aoe> | any<global> | any<harmful_aura & inc_damage & stronger> @ boss | pass
description: Support for a boss that cheats when a Blade is cast; it never casts or enchants one. Mass Feint, Feint and traps on the boss, each that stacks before the same ones that don't, then a global, then a negative aura such as Attenuate on the boss when it beats the aura there, and it passes rather than spend P1's buffs. Once P1 is dead, it attacks.
